# Plan: Mamba/Attention/Router/Shared-Expert Offloading for Nemotron-H on 12GB GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Correctness Risks

### Tensor Inventory & Sizes (31B-A3-5B config)
Based on `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp` architecture parameters and standard MoE scaling:

| Tensor Category | Exact Names (per layer) | Approx. Size (FP16) | Overflow Risk |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mamba SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | ~14.2 MB/layer | **Low** (SSM params are ~1/10 the size of FFN) |
| **Attention QKV** | `attn_norm`, QKV projection (via `create_tensor_qkv`) | ~20.5 MB/layer | **Medium** (standard attention) |
| **Router / Gate** | `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b` | ~8.2 MB/layer | **Low** (small gate bias) |
| **Expert Down/Up** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps` | **~112 MB/layer** (64 experts × 1k dim) | **Critical** |
| **Shared Experts** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | **~6.4 MB/layer** (shared FFN) | **Medium** |

**Critical Constraint**: A 12GB GPU must simultaneously hold:
- 1 input embedding (~80MB)
- 1 output norm + lm_head (~80MB)
- **~52 layers × (Attn ~20MB + MoE Experts ~112MB + Shared ~6MB + SSM ~14MB)**
- **Total ≈ 52 × 152MB ≈ 7.9GB** for weights alone.

This leaves < 4GB for KV cache, computation graphs, and overhead—**insufficient** for standard 31B MoE prefill/decode on 12GB.
